plugins.name: interactive-book
plugins.description: Build an interactive 3D book that teaches any topic, one lesson per spread: predict, lift the flap, play with an ink-drawn figure, meet the challenge. Tests it in headless Chrome, publishes to GitHub Pages and records a video for X.
